q: Do hydropower reservoirs emit greenhouse gases?
title: Hydro reservoir methane
short: They can: flooded vegetation and soils decompose and release methane, especially in warm, shallow reservoirs. Grid emission factors count only combustion, so reservoir methane is not in the 0.710 (FY 2024-25 grid factor) figure. Hydro operators can estimate it using IPCC guidance on flooded land.
audience: Hydropower operators and buyers of hydro power

ul: Methane from reservoirs is reported separately with the method named.
It varies widely by climate, depth and how much biomass was flooded.
Non fossil methane has a 100 year warming potential of 27.0 in IPCC AR6.

p: Your Scope 2 uses the grid or contract factor. Reservoir emissions belong to the generator's inventory, not yours.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
